title: Instructions générales pour remplir la déclaration d'impôt des personnes physiques
why_needed: Official 2025 guide for the personal return: cantonal, communal and federal direct tax, e-filing steps, extensions.
notes: Cover: Impôt fédéral direct 2025, edition SCCOI754V15. Same content also at https://www.ne.ch/autorites/DFS/SCCO/Documents/PP/INSTRUCTIONS_GENERALES.pdf (verified).

title: Instructions générales personnes physiques - Départ à l'étranger ou décès
why_needed: Only for an intermediate return on departure abroad or death, not the ordinary return.
notes: Cover marks Impôt fédéral direct 2026, edition SCCOI759V16. Cannot be made in Clic&Tax or sent through the Guichet unique; signed paper only.

title: Barème de référence détaillé sur le revenu - Périodes fiscales 2024 à 2026 (splitting à 52%)
why_needed: Base income tax table for individuals (coefficient 1.00), to be multiplied by the cantonal and communal coefficients.
notes: Coefficients page lists it as valid for periods 2024 to 2026. The PDF itself is headed as applicable from 1 January 2024. No separate 2025 file was found.

title: Barème de référence détaillé sur la fortune - Périodes fiscales 2021 et suivantes (splitting à 52%)
why_needed: Base wealth tax table for individuals (coefficient 1.00), to be multiplied by the cantonal and communal coefficients.
notes: PDF headed as applicable from 1 January 2021. Separate columns for single persons and married persons.

title: Décret modifiant le décret fixant les coefficients de l'impôt cantonal direct et de l'impôt communal direct dus par les personnes physiques
publisher: Grand Conseil, République et Canton de Neuchâtel (Feuille officielle)
why_needed: Sets the cantonal coefficient that applies to tax year 2025 (and 2026); needed to turn base tax into tax due.
notes: Feuille officielle no 50 of 12 December 2025, decree dated 2 December 2025. Covers 2025 and 2026. Its entry-into-force article is reported as 1 January 2026, check the text. Does not list communal coefficients by commune.

title: Décret fixant les coefficients de l'impôt cantonal direct et de l'impôt communal direct dus par les personnes physiques
why_needed: Consolidated base decree on coefficients; explains how communal coefficients are derived from each commune's own coefficient.
notes: Dated 2 December 2013, in force 1 January 2014, consolidated as of 1 January 2026. Contains no per-commune table.

title: Loi sur les contributions directes (LCdir)
why_needed: Cantonal legal basis for income, wealth, deductions and source tax.
notes: RSN 631.0, act of 21 March 2000, consolidated as of 1 January 2026. Only part of the text was readable; the source-tax and rectification articles were not in the excerpt reviewed.

title: Aperçu des bases de calcul pour les barèmes cantonaux de l'impôt à la source année fiscale 2026
publisher: Service des contributions (SCCO), Neuchâtel (footnotes cite AFC)
why_needed: Shows which deductions are already built into the 2026 source-tax tables. Source-tax only, not the ordinary return.
notes: Uploaded January 2026. Covers the federal and cantonal source-tax bases. Do not use for ordinary-return deductions.

title: Coefficients et barèmes
why_needed: Index of the current cantonal income and wealth tables and federal IFD tables; check here for 2026 updates.
notes: Links income tables for 2024 to 2026 and wealth tables from 2021, plus IFD tables per year. No source-tax tariff and no commune-by-commune coefficient table linked.

title: Taxation ordinaire ultérieure (TOU)
why_needed: Official TOU rules: who may request it, deadline (31 March of the following year), irrevocability, compulsory cases.
notes: Gives no rectification rules or deadline. Compulsory TOU applies automatically the following year.

title: Demande de taxation ordinaire ultérieure (TOU)
why_needed: The TOU request form; the request is due by 31 March of the following year.
notes: Form reference SCCOF7203V2, revised 21.11.2022. Both spouses or registered partners sign. Send to the Office de l'impôt à la source, La Chaux-de-Fonds.

title: Impôt à la source et frontaliers
why_needed: Entry point to the source-tax information and to the TOU page.
notes: Links no source-tax tariff, no rectification deadline and no TOU deadline.

title: Retourner la déclaration d'impôt par internet ?
why_needed: Official step-by-step for filing through the Guichet unique with Clic&Tax, including the signature exception and the ban on email.
notes: Edition SCCO December 2025. No login details, no third-party software rules and no deadlines in the text.

title: Clic & Tax
why_needed: Official download page for the free return software and its Guichet unique instructions.
notes: Current release 25.3.31 dated 06.10.2026. Says the printed declaration goes in the original official form. Recommends an external product for professional use.

title: Service des contributions
why_needed: Official SCCO hub: contacts, the Clic&Tax 2025 release notice and payment dates.
notes: States the Clic&Tax 2025 version is available. Shows the 8th instalment for 2026 due 31 October 2026 (a payment date, not a return deadline).

title: Impôt des personnes physiques
why_needed: Index of personal tax documents: guide, Clic&Tax, Guichet unique, deadline and extension pages.
notes: Refers to deadlines on linked pages without giving dates. Links the guide, the deadline-request page and the documents page.

title: Documents, attestations et liens utiles - impôt des personnes physiques
why_needed: Index of notices, circulars, the deadline-request form and expense-related documents.
notes: Lists notices 1 to 5 and AFC circulars 11, 26, 28, 30 and 31. No crypto-asset guidance. Deadline and attestation requests are subject to fees.
